smoke_test: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && docker compose up -d postgres redis && pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test all succeed, and the app boots with GET /health returning 200
notes: Do not overwrite CLAUDE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/bc-map.md or docs/adr/0001-initial-setup.md; keep the command names CLAUDE.md already lists.
No new bounded contexts: exactly identity, integrations, contribution, bonus-review (schema bonus_review), billing.
Windows developer machine: every command is a pnpm script; the existing Makefile stays as an alias only.
Pin exact dependency versions that exist at scaffold time; NestJS 11, Node 22, PostgreSQL 16.

tasks.title: Create the NestJS 11 project skeleton with the five context modules and the shared kernel folders
tasks.dod: pnpm build succeeds with TypeScript strict, and pnpm start boots an app whose AppModule imports exactly the five context modules (each with an empty public/index.ts and the inner layout from docs/bc-map.md §4) and serves GET /health → 200

tasks.title: Wire the Jest harness: colocated unit specs, integration/e2e under test/, Supertest smoke test
tasks.dod: pnpm test runs every suite and is green; pnpm test:unit runs only src/**/*.spec.ts without Docker; pnpm test:int runs test/**/*.{int,e2e}-spec.ts including a Supertest e2e asserting GET /health → 200; pnpm test src/<path>.spec.ts runs a single file

tasks.title: Add docker-compose (Postgres 16, Redis 7) and validated environment configuration
tasks.dod: docker compose up -d postgres redis reports both healthy; the app refuses to boot with a clear message when DATABASE_URL or REDIS_URL is missing or malformed (unit-tested), and .env.example lists every variable with a fake value

tasks.title: Set up Prisma per context: five schema files, five generated clients inside the modules, five migration histories
tasks.dod: pnpm db:generate produces five clients into gitignored src/modules/<context>/**/db/generated/; pnpm db:migrate applies an initial migration per context to a fresh database so that each of the schemas identity, integrations, contribution, bonus_review, billing exists with its own _prisma_migrations table; each initial migration has a down.sql that reverts it cleanly; an integration test proves every context client connects to its own schema (verifies ADR 0002)

tasks.title: Implement shared primitives: UUIDv7 ids, injectable Clock, Money
tasks.dod: unit specs pass for newId() (valid UUIDv7, time-ordered), SystemClock/FixedClock behind a Clock injection token, and Money (integer amountCents + ISO currency, rejects non-integers and currency mismatch); src/shared imports nothing from src/modules

tasks.title: Add DomainError base and the global exception filter with the error envelope
tasks.dod: an e2e spec shows a thrown DomainError subclass maps to its HTTP status with body { error: { code, message } }, and an unknown error maps to 500 without a stack trace in the body

tasks.title: Configure ESLint + Prettier with eslint-plugin-boundaries enforcing the cross-context import rule
tasks.dod: pnpm lint is green on the skeleton; a lint self-test runs ESLint over fixture files and fails on (a) a module importing another module's non-public path, (b) a module importing another module's generated Prisma client, (c) src/shared importing src/modules, (d) an import cycle between modules — while an import of modules/<other>/public/** and of shared/** passes

tasks.title: Wire BullMQ on Redis and the in-process event bus
tasks.dod: the app boots with @nestjs/bullmq connected to Redis and @nestjs/event-emitter registered; an integration spec enqueues a no-op job and observes it completed; GET /health reports Postgres and Redis status

tasks.title: Implement the per-context outbox: transactional write, relay job, consumer deduplication by eventId
tasks.dod: an integration spec writes a test event to one context's outbox inside a transaction, the relay publishes it on the event bus and a subscriber receives it once; writing the same eventId twice stores one row, redelivering it is ignored by the consumer, and a rolled-back transaction publishes nothing

tasks.title: Add the GitHub Actions CI workflow
tasks.dod: the workflow file is valid (actionlint passes if available), uses Node 22, pnpm with a frozen lockfile and Postgres 16 + Redis service containers, and runs exactly the package.json scripts db:generate, lint, typecheck, build, db:migrate, test
